about: Every number this video shows or says. The three prices are read on each maker's own public pricing page on Nov 1, 2026 (the run that made this lesson); page shots in video/studio/demos/out/2026-11-15-three-fixes-1/. The $2,800 a month is OUR worked example from the lesson before (2026-11-13-count-before-ai), labeled EXAMPLE on screen. No vendor is recommended; each is one example of its kind.

textback.monthlyNote: $19 per user a month billed monthly ($15 billed annually); carrier fees extra: $19.50 one-time review and a messaging fee of $1.50 to $3 a month
textback.feature: Auto-replies on all plans: automatically respond to texts, missed calls, or voicemails with pre-defined messages.
textback.catches: the caller's number and a text back
textback.misses: the booking: you still call them back

person.vendor: PATLive, Pay as you go plan
person.note: $49 a month billed monthly, no included minutes, additional minutes $2.99 each; taxes and fees extra; the page says it does not use AI to answer calls
person.catches: the whole call, taken by a person
person.misses: nothing on the call, but every minute is billed, so long calls cost more

ai.note: $49 per month, 250 minutes per month; 7-day free trial; English and Spanish
ai.misses: test it on your own hard calls before you trust it

example.source: OURS: the worked example from 2026-11-13-count-before-ai (14 missed calls in 2 weeks, 4 real jobs, $350 cleared a job), labeled EXAMPLE on screen

press.source: Contractor magazine, The Missed Call Math Most Contractors Never Run, Oct 15, 2026
press.note: names an answering service or AI receptionist for after-hours gaps and a text soon after a missed call; used only as the sign owners are asking, not as a number
